author: Kairos II
title: Build roll-50 evolution × liminal overlay variant (preserve baseline)
abstract: Creates a 50-tick rolling damped_liminal_count CSV, builds the overlay, copies outputs to roll50 files, then rebuilds the baseline overlay to preserve default outputs. Prints variant/baseline paths.

original_submission.content:
import sys, subprocess, json, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
evol_dir = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution')
nova_csv = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv')
roll_csv = nova_csv.parent / 'liminal_timeseries_roll50.csv'
overlays_dir = evol_dir / 'overlays'
overlays_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Build roll-50 CSV
df = pd.read_csv(nova_csv)
if 'tick' not in df.columns:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps({"error": "missing_tick_column"}))
# Find liminal column
lcol = None
for c in ['damped_liminal_count','liminal_count','liminal_score','damped_count']:
    if c in df.columns:
        lcol = c; break
if not lcol:
    for c in df.columns:
        if c != 'tick' and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c]):
            lcol = c; break
if not lcol:
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps({"error": "missing_liminal_column"}))

df = df.sort_values('tick')
# rolling window 50 ticks (by count)
df_rolled = df[['tick', lcol]].copy()
df_rolled[lcol] = df_rolled[lcol].rolling(window=50, min_periods=1).mean()
df_rolled.to_csv(roll_csv, index=False)

# 2) Run overlay builder with roll-50 CSV
cmd_roll = [
  sys.executable,
  str(evol_dir / 'build_evolution_liminal_overlay.py'),
  '--nova_csv', str(roll_csv)
]
cp1 = subprocess.run(cmd_roll, capture_output=True, text=True)
out1 = cp1.stdout.strip()
# 3) Copy outputs to roll50-named files
base_png = overlays_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay.png'
base_sum = overlays_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_summary.txt'
roll_png = overlays_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_roll50.png'
roll_sum = overlays_dir / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_roll50_summary.txt'
if base_png.exists():
    roll_png.write_bytes(base_png.read_bytes())
if base_sum.exists():
    roll_sum.write_bytes(base_sum.read_bytes())

# 4) Restore baseline overlay using original CSV
cmd_base = [
  sys.executable,
  str(evol_dir / 'build_evolution_liminal_overlay.py'),
  '--nova_csv', str(nova_csv)
]
cp2 = subprocess.run(cmd_base, capture_output=True, text=True)
out2 = cp2.stdout.strip()

print(json.dumps({
  "roll50_panel": str(roll_png),
  "roll50_summary": str(roll_sum),
  "baseline_panel": str(base_png),
  "baseline_summary": str(base_sum),
  "builder_roll_stdout": out1[-400:],
  "builder_base_stdout": out2[-400:]
}))
